This '''Jedi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Lost Suns 4" /> This Jedi trained [[Ngani Zho]] as well as two [[Human/Legends|humans]] and a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] at the ruins of the old [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

Zho would remember his old master when reminiscing on his past later in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Lost Suns 4" />
